## About Adam Wanninger

Adam Wanninger is a technology leader with a background in product management — the kind of PM who still reads the diff. Today he spends his time helping teams build software worth using; before that, he shipped it himself.

He began his career as a proud member of the Ruby on Rails community, which shaped how he thinks about craft, convention, and welcoming newcomers.

He is an Executive Director of Digital Product Management & User Experience Design with over a decade of experience leading product and platform teams, primarily in the FinTech and financial services industry. He has held senior product leadership roles at Fortune 100 companies including JPMorgan Chase and Wells Fargo. His work spans digital product strategy, platform engineering, continuous delivery, organizational design, and user experience.

Adam is based in the United States.

## Open Source

- **QueensCoach** — an MCP server for live Charlotte Area Transit (CATS) bus and rail data.
  https://github.com/ajwann/queenscoach
- **installed-api** — a Claude Code plugin (an MCP server) that answers API questions from the
  packages installed in a project rather than from memory or web docs. Also listed in the Anthropic Directory.
  https://github.com/ajwann/installed-api
  https://claude.ai/customize/plugins/id/433c257a-1541-4b46-9fee-9300cebb9fce%40anthropic-plugin-directory
- **svg-loaders-react** — a React adaptation of the SVG Loaders library.
  https://github.com/ajwann/svg-loaders-react
- **RubyGems and Bundler** — 18 commits, including a `bundle bin` path fix and a proper PathError.
  https://github.com/ruby/rubygems/commits?author=ajwann

  https://github.com/ruby/ruby/commit/aad7443e168880e382680d4c0be1757840b23c18

  https://github.com/exercism/ruby/commits?author=ajwann

## Professional Philosophy & Public Writing (LinkedIn)

Adam is an active voice on LinkedIn on topics including:

- **Continuous Delivery in regulated industries:** Argues that CD adoption is blocked not by tools but by organizational culture and architecture — silos, fear of failure, and rigid release management processes. Believes CD is achievable even in highly regulated industries with the right design.

- **Organizational Design:** Shares a framework for tech leadership org design, emphasizing starting with clear objectives, guiding principles for trade-offs, and balancing quick wins with long-term structure. Views org design as leadership work connecting structure to strategy.

- **Product leadership and mentorship:** Regularly mentors senior product managers on navigating job hunts, interviews, case studies, and the evolving expectations of the PM role.

## Site Structure

The site (https://awanninger.com) is a single-page personal landing page. All content is in the static HTML (no JavaScript required). It contains:

- Profile photo (https://awanninger.com/aw-200.jpg)
- Name: Adam Wanninger
- Tagline: "Passionate technology leader, former Rubyist, and occasional open source contributor"
- Five expandable sections:
  - **About** — a short bio
  - **Connect** — LinkedIn, GitHub, and email
  - **Open Source** — the projects listed above
  - **Talks** — Product Coffee podcast and Ohio LinuxFest 2021
  - **Articles** — the two HackerNoon articles listed above

There is no blog or multi-page structure. Machine-readable summaries live at /llms.txt and /llms-full.txt.
